description: This file defines the 'Registry' class used for managing a collection of objects in the OpenCart system. It provides methods for setting, getting, checking existence, and unsetting objects associated with string keys, serving as a dependency container or service registry.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: A class providing a registry or container for storing and retrieving objects via string keys within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method enabling property-like access to the registry's items, internally calls 'get'.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method enabling property-like setting of items, internally calls 'set'.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if a key exists in the registry, internally calls 'has'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the object associated with a given key, or null if not set.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores an object under a specific key within the registry.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks whether a key exists in the registry.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated object from the registry.
